sentences.en: Please speak more loudly so that everybody can hear you.
sentences.zh: 请大声一点说话，让大家都能听到你。

sentences.en: I spoke so loudly as to be heard by everyone.
sentences.zh: 我讲得很大声，以至于所有人都能听见。

sentences.en: I felt like singing loudly when the exam was over.
sentences.zh: 考试结束后，我觉得很想高声唱歌。

senses.zh: 高声地；吵闹地花哨地，华丽地
